# Intuition Docs (V2)

Version: V2
Scope: V2 covers the packages in the release manifest and Intuition Core.
The V2 packages are published as stable npm releases and Intuition Core is a release candidate.
Other versions: V1 — https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/llms.txt

Start with the shipped V2 overview, install contract-level agent skills, or find community support. The complete V1 documentation remains available through the other-version index above.

- [llms-full.txt](https://docs.intuition.systems/llms-full.txt): Complete text of the shipped V2 pages
- [llms-medium.txt](https://docs.intuition.systems/llms-medium.txt): Condensed V2 page summaries with metadata

## Start here

- [Intuition V2](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs): Overview of the V2 documentation generation
- [Agent skills](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/agents/skills): Install the intuition and erc8004-agent-layer contract-level skills for V1 and V2
- [Community](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/community): Get help and connect with the Intuition community
